tool_args.rationale: The pilot explicitly reports sig:high_freq_sign_oscillation. Per the task rules, this is sufficient to abstain rather than assert a stationary smooth law or purchase additional observations.

considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The reported high-frequency sign oscillation triggers the scoped-unknown rule; fitting a smooth stationary model from more points would not resolve whether the law is nonstationary.

considered_alternatives.option: Weibull, Avrami, or Richards smooth stationary models
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: These authorized mechanisms are smooth monotonic snapshots and cannot account for the observed high-frequency sign oscillation.
It is irrelevant to resolving the reported oscillatory behavior and has unnecessary cost.
